name: demo-dialogue
prompt: A bright 3D animated children's educational scene, medium shot. The two referenced characters stand beside the cut-off corner of a wooden garden fence and talk to each other with natural lip sync and head motion. The mother points at the fence corner while she speaks; the child listens, then answers excitedly and jumps. The fence has evenly spaced wooden posts and two horizontal rails. Soft green grass, clear sky, warm sunlight, clean stylized Pixar-like rendering, consistent appearance of both characters.

figures.name: mom
figures.describe: the mother with short dark hair, round glasses, a teal shirt, a brown belt with a tool pouch and white trousers

figures.name: kid
figures.describe: her small child, a little boy with messy dark hair wearing a yellow overall over a white t-shirt and blue sneakers

dialogue.speaker: mom
dialogue.text: 剪掉一个角，围栏就能少用一点吗？

dialogue.speaker: kid
dialogue.text: 妈妈，少掉的那一段围栏去哪儿了？
